translation:
Treats all external barriers and similar syndromes, like the method of opening a pot lid. Always keep the evil poison from being blocked, giving it a way out. Yet its power is small and sharp; when snuffed into the nose it takes effect at once, so one should always gather its power.

Ebushicao (2 qian), Qingdai (1 qian), Chuanxiong (1 qian).

Grind the above into fine powder. First hold a mouthful of water in the mouth; each time use about a grain of rice, snuff it into the nose, until tears come out.
translator_notes: 㗜 (xiu) means snuffing the medicine into the nose.
鵝不食草 (Ebushicao) is a herb whose name means 'the goose does not eat the grass'.
開鍋蓋法 (opening the pot lid method) means opening an outlet for the evil poison, like opening a pot lid.
